facts.population: Partially or completely edentulous patients with an RPD connected to implant-surveyed crowns/bridges
facts.intervention: Implant-surveyed crowns and/or bridges for RPD (ICRPD)
facts.comparison: Conventional RPD on natural tooth abutments and implants used as attachment system under RPD/CD
facts.main_result: Implant survival rates in included studies ranged 95.1% to 100% and success rates 70.9% to 90.6%.
facts.sample_size: 31 eligible studies (9 retrospective, 21 case reports, 1 systematic review)
facts.limitations: Clinical evidence is mostly retrospective studies and case reports; no quality assessment was undertaken.
facts.key_finding: This review of 31 studies found implant-surveyed-crown RPDs had implant survival of 95.1-100% with low marginal bone loss and good prognoses in case reports. Evidence is limited to retrospective studies and case reports.
facts.clinical_bottom_line: Implants used as surveyed crowns in RPDs appear a reliable option, ideally placed near anterior teeth or premolars, though evidence is low-level.
